_comment: POST /api/assistant - the in-page learning assistant. Streams back over SSE. The assistant is EXPLAIN-ONLY: it never writes to the editor, never runs code, and never sees run output. On practice problems it gives hints and refuses to produce the solution - the reveal button is the only route to an answer.

history._comment: Prior turns in this conversation. Reset when the learner moves to another day.

response._comment: SSE events, not a JSON body. `delta` carries text chunks; `done` closes the turn; `error` reports a failure the client should surface rather than retry silently.
